stripWindow.autoAssistOffsetXTitle: Simple horizontal offset after detect (positive = right, negative = left)
stripWindow.autoAssistExtraRightTitle: Extra leftward shift after detect (0-120 px) to trim remaining black border on the right
stripWindow.autoAssistExtraTopTitle: Shift raster DOWN (0–120). Negatives allowed: become Extra B (up). Or use Y-offset (− = up)

stripWindow.autoAssistDarkLineLeftBiasTi: Extra left micro-shift for preset 'Black line' (works in Soft and Strong)
stripWindow.autoAssistDarkLineStrongScal: Multiplier for 'Black left bias' when Assist is set to Strong (1x-48x)
Automatically choose Strong scale per scan based on remaining border quality
stripWindow.autoAssistDarkBottomBiasTitl: Vertical fine-tune for black bottom edge with preset 'Black line' (positive = slightly higher)
stripWindow.autoAssistDarkLineThicknessT: Thickness for horizontal black-line detection (1=thin aperture line, 5=medium, 10=thick frame bar). Adjust per film type.
stripWindow.autoAssistDarkLineSearchRang: How far (± px) to search around the current edges: horizontal black line (top/bottom) and vertical frame edges (left/right). Smaller = more stable; larger = catches bigger shifts.
stripWindow.autoAssistSearchRangeGuideTi: Show search range as an overlay around the active frame (± px). Also appears automatically while editing the value.
stripWindow.autoAssistTriangleSensitivit: Starting white sensitivity (0–100). Detect also tries 10/30/50/70/99 and picks the best tip/seam. Manual value is a hint; extremes (10 or 99) are rarely needed now.

pixelEditor.hint: Paint over dust or unwanted pixels on the active frame with the left mouse button. Eyedropper picks a color. Brush mode “Underlying scan” clones grain from the scan next to the brush (pick left/right/above/below toward clean area) for natural blends. Right-click or Ctrl+Z undoes strokes. Feather softens the brush edge. Edits apply to previews and frame export while the strip is loaded. To write painted frames to disk, choose a pixel editor folder and use Previous / Next (each step saves the current frame as PNG if it has paint). Raster setup still saves grid settings only, not pixel layers in the project file. The optional source folder (scans) is only for the pixel editor; Raster setup keeps the project strip. Use ◀ File / File ▶ to step through images in that folder.
